// divguard:path ai/openai.go

package ai

import (
	"bufio"
	"io"
	"strings"
)

// readSSE reproduces AI-07: `data:{...}` without the space is dropped and
// multi-line data is never joined.
func readSSE(r io.Reader, emit func(event, data string)) {
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(r)
	event := ""
	for sc.Scan() {
		line := sc.Text()
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "event: ") { // want
			event = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "event: ") // want
			continue
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "data: ") { // want
			continue
		}
		emit(event, strings.TrimPrefix(line, "data: ")) // want
	}
}
